SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B./REGISTR4701.
No. D 4701
S.2, Sp. Br.
Date 9 / 5 / 33
May 9, 1933.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Confidential despatch dated March 29, 1933 addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Police re communist activities among the
local unemployed and refugees.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to confidential letter, character "Tseng"
( 增 ), dated March 29, 1933, addressed to the Shanghai Municipal
Police from General Wen Hung En, Chief of the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, on the subject of the plans of the Central
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party to organize several
Unemployed and Refugee Corps in the various districts of Shanghai,
I have to report that according to independent enquiries made
by C.D.S.155 and C.D.C.280 and information from other sources,
the local Chinese Communist Party have made practically no
progress in their attempt to organize Unemployed and Refugee
Corps in the "Eastern", "Western", "Central", "Chapei" and
"French Concession and Nantao" Districts. This may be due
to the fact of the numerous raids made by the local authorities
on important communist bases during the past few months. It
could almost be safely said that the local Chinese Communist
Party is at present without efficient leadership especially in
view of the fact that very feeble efforts were made to exploit
the recent explosions of vulcanizers in two rubber factories
which resulted in a heavy loss of life.

Regarding the statement to the effect that the Central
Committee of the Communist Party would detail persons to lead
the unemployed and refugees to the Social Bureau to demand
relief, etc., this form of propaganda has appeared at various
times in communist handbills, but so far has not materialized.

[签名]
Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

1933年5月9日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

事由（全称） 关于1933年3月29日致上海公共租界工部局警务处的机密公函，内容涉及当地失业者及难民中的共产党活动。

由 督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa) 呈报 转呈 [签名]

兹就上海市公安局局长温宏恩 (Wen Hung En) 于1933年3月29日致上海公共租界工部局警务处、代字为“增”的机密信函所述事项，即中国共产党中央委员会计划在上海各区组织若干失业者与难民团一事，经本处 C.D.S.155 及 C.D.C.280 独立调查并结合其他来源情报，现报告如下：本地中国共产党在“东区”、“西区”、“中区”、“闸北”以及“法租界及南市”各区组织失业者与难民团的尝试实际上未取得任何进展。这可能是由于过去几个月地方当局对重要共产党基地进行了多次搜查所致。几乎可以肯定地说，本地中国共产党目前缺乏有效的领导，尤其是鉴于其未能充分利用近期两家橡胶厂硫化罐爆炸造成重大人员伤亡的事件这一事实，其所作努力微乎其微。

关于所谓共产党中央委员会将指派人员带领失业者和难民前往社会局要求救济等说法，此类宣传虽曾不时出现在共产党的传单中，但迄今并未成为现实。

[签名]
顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa)
督察
特科主管。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4701
Character 7 133

Translation of a despatch No. 34,
"Tseng" (政), dated March 29, 1933, from the Chief of the
Public Safety Bureau to the Commissioner of the Shanghai
Municipal Police.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
We beg to inform you that, according to a secret
report, the so-called Central Committee of the Communist
Party is planning to organise several Unemployed and
Refugees Corps in Shanghai. These Corps will be inaugurated
in 5 districts, namely: (1) the Eastern District, (2) the
Western District, (3) the French Concession and Nantao
District, (4) the Central District, (5) the Chapei District
and each of these Corps will consist of 1,500 persons. As
soon as the required number of persons has been secured,
an inaugural meeting will be held and the so-called Central
Committee of the Communist Party will detail persons to
lead them to the Social Bureau to ask for relief and to
demand the issue of various kinds of relief contributions
as well as of the funds raised from the Charity Champions
Sweepstakes. Should their demands be rejected, they plan
to surround the premises of the Bureau and create disturbances.
Apart from instructing my subordinates to take
precautionary measures, I hereby request you to order your
men to do likewise.

(Signed) Wen Hoong-en,
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau.

$2, for .
D. I. Kuhn.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. B. 登记处
编号 D 4701
代字 7 133

译自上海市公安局局长于1933年3月29日发出的第34号公函，代字“政”，致上海公共租界工部局警务处处长。

致：
上海工部局警务处处长。

先生：
谨此奉告，据秘密报告，所谓的共产党中央委员会正计划在上海组织若干失业者与难民团。这些团体将在五个区成立，即：(1) 东区，(2) 西区，(3) 法租界及南区，(4) 中区，(5) 闸北区，每个团体将由1,500人组成。一旦凑足所需人数，将举行成立大会，所谓的共产党中央委员会将指派人员带领他们前往社会局请求救济，并要求发放各类救济捐款以及从慈善冠军彩票募捐所得的资金。如果他们的要求被拒绝，他们计划包围该局办公场所并制造骚乱。
除已指示下属采取预防措施外，特此请贵处命令所属警员亦采取同样措施。

（签名）温宏恩 (Wen Hoong-en)，
市公安局局长。

$2, for .
督察 Kuhn.
ABR 29/3
